source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Mail and feed summary rendering use the same mailnews.display preferences and MsgBody actions. In the current global menu, feed body modes are hidden only for the global webpage override. The message-header menu instead uses !FeedMessageHandler.gShowSummary, because a per-folder setting can decide what the displayed message shows. Keep that distinction when consolidating menus. Both menus retain separate radio groups for webpage-versus-summary selection and summary HTML rendering. The browser test checks preferences, previous checked state and unavailable modes in webpage view; its native macOS menubar tasks are skipped.
title: Feed display modes share mail render preferences but keep menu-specific visibility
